+def _normalize_param_name(name: str) -> str:
+    """Normalize parameter name by removing leading asterisks.
+    
+    This is used to match parameter names in docstrings (which may have *args or **kwargs)
+    with parameter names in the signature (which don't have asterisks).
+    """
+    return name.lstrip('*')
+
+
